message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-05 13:10 IST to 2026-11-06 13:10 IST

No newly published vulnerability was verified in the last 24 hours as a confident match for the normalized DLL component inventory. One material advisory update is a possible component-family match and needs environment review.

### Possible match needing review: System.IO.Compression / CVE-2026-111497

- **Affected product or component:** .NET Brotli decoder exposed through System.IO.Compression Brotli APIs, ASP.NET Core request decompression, or HttpClient automatic response decompression
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-111497, out-of-bounds write in Brotli decoding
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 8.1 (Microsoft)
- **Freshness:** AWS updated its security bulletin on 2026-11-05 at 14:00 PST, within this scan window; the underlying Microsoft advisory was originally published on 2026-10-25.
- **Description:** Processing attacker-controlled Brotli-compressed data with an affected .NET 8-11 decoder can read or corrupt process memory, potentially causing information disclosure, denial of service, or elevation of privilege.
- **Why it may be relevant:** The inventory contains System.IO.Compression 4.3.0. Microsoft names System.IO.Compression Brotli APIs as an exposure path, but its affected package/runtime ranges are .NET 8-11 and NativeAOT packages rather than the listed 4.3.0 package. Confirm the deployed .NET runtime and whether the application processes untrusted Brotli data before treating this inventory entry as affected.
- **Sources:** [Microsoft .NET advisory](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/security/advisories/GHSA-p3jp-9v83-76w9), [Microsoft .NET update](https://devblogs.microsoft.com/dotnet/dotnet-october-2026-oob-security-updates/), [AWS bulletin updated November 5](https://aws.amazon.com/security/security-bulletins/2026-155-aws/)

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official integrations. No fresh, credible MongoDB finding was verified inside the 24-hour window. The newest authoritative MongoDB alerts found were dated 2026-11-03 and were excluded as outside the cutoff.

**Closing:** Immediate incident response is not indicated from this DLL scan. Review the deployed .NET runtime and Brotli usage because the in-window advisory update has a plausible but unconfirmed relationship to the listed System.IO.Compression component.
